lines.text: A business is more than its logo.
lines.phonemes: ɐ bˈɪznəs ɪz mˈɔːɹ ðɐn ɪts lˈoʊɡoʊ.

lines.text: It's how its products are presented, how it communicates, and the experience people have when they interact with it.
lines.phonemes: ɪts hˌaʊ ɪts pɹˈɑːdʌkts ɑːɹ pɹɪzˈɛntᵻd, hˌaʊ ɪt kəmjˈuːnᵻkˌeɪts, ænd ðɪ ɛkspˈiəɹɪəns pˈiːpəl hæv wɛn ðeɪ ˌɪntɚɹˈækt wɪð ɪt.

lines.text: That's why good design shouldn't happen in isolation.
lines.phonemes: ðæts wˌaɪ ɡˈʊd dɪzˈaɪn ʃˌʊdənt hˈæpən ɪn ˌaɪsəlˈeɪʃən.

lines.text: At Designwave, we start by understanding the business, then build a creative direction that connects its identity, digital presence, and visual communication.
lines.phonemes: æt dɪzˈaɪnweɪv, wiː stˈɑːɹt baɪ ˌʌndɚstˈændɪŋ ðə bˈɪznəs, ðˈɛn bˈɪld ɐ kɹiːˈeɪɾɪv dᵻɹˈɛkʃən ðæt kənˈɛkts ɪts aɪdˈɛntᵻɾi, dˈɪdʒɪɾəl pɹˈɛzəns, ænd vˈɪʒuːəl kəmjˌuːnɪkˈeɪʃən.

lines.text: Because every detail contributes to the bigger picture.
lines.phonemes: bɪkˈʌz ˈɛvɹi diːtˈeɪl kəntɹˈɪbjuːts tə ðə bˈɪɡɚ pˈɪktʃɚ.
